google_review_notes: No login required. Age Calculator opens on the Age tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Pick a date of birth to see the exact age, next birthday, zodiac and milestones; Difference compares two dates; People saves birthdays (3 free, more with Pro) with an optional weekly reminder. Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. No demo account needed.
